clue.text: Having less hair a bit rubbish

parts.note: balder means having less hair on the head
a dash is a small amount, a bit of something

explanation.surface: Someone thinning on top is dismissed as slightly worthless.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean nonsense, senseless talk or writing: a synonym.

clue.text: A shade insensitive

definitions.meaning: a window covering that keeps out light
unable to perceive, as in ... to someone's feelings

explanation.surface: Something is called slightly unfeeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A window covering is a shade, and someone unaware of something is said to be oblivious to it.

clue.text: Dalek I set loose on harsh northern wilderness

indicators.note: set loose suggests the letters are freed and scattered into a new order

parts.note: strict means severe or harsh

explanation.surface: A Doctor Who Dalek is released onto a bleak northern landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set loose' turns DALEKI into LAKEDI. A Dalek is a robotic villain from the British TV series Doctor Who.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cumbrian lakes and fells in north-west England form a scenic, wild upland area.

clue.text: Greek god found in Homer, ostensibly

indicators.note: found in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A deity appears, apparently, in the epics of Homer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of love, the counterpart of Cupid.

clue.text: Vague padre, dismissing pa and girl

indicators.note: dismissing means sending away, so pa is removed from padre

parts.note: taken as written; a padre is a military chaplain
taken as written
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: An unfocused chaplain sends away his father and a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissing' takes PA from PADRE to leave DRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamy means absent-minded and hazy, lost in thought.

clue.text: Sporting competition that's in the bag?

definitions.text: Sporting competition that's in the bag?

parts.words: Sporting competition that's in the bag?
parts.note: in the bag usually means certain to be won, but here racers literally stand inside sacks

explanation.surface: A contest whose result is already guaranteed.
explanation.definitionFit: In this school sports-day race, runners hop along with their legs inside sacks.

clue.text: What could delay a novel bowlers' trick being used

indicators.note: being used suggests the letters are put to work in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A cricketing ruse slows the arrival of something new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like the adjective 'new' but is the book. 'being used' rearranges BOWLERS TRICK; bowlers are cricket's pitchers.
explanation.definitionFit: An author's inability to produce new work stalls the completion of a book.

clue.text: Gloomy detective imprisons leader of Opposition

indicators.note: imprisons means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: Inspector Morse is the Oxford detective of novels and British TV

indicators.note: leader of points to the first letter of Opposition

explanation.surface: A downcast sleuth locks up the head of the opposition party.
explanation.definitionFit: Sullen and melancholy in mood: a synonym for gloomy.

clue.text: One miserable smoker is irritating

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

indicators.note: miserable means in a wretched state, so the letters of smoker are put into a sorry new order

explanation.surface: A lone unhappy smoker gets on everyone's nerves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'miserable' reads as a description of the smoker, but it is the anagram signal; 'One' gives the Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tiresome and annoying is irritating: a straight synonym.

clue.text: Goods initially carried by ancient ship

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word carried

parts.note: the Argo was the ship of Jason and the Argonauts in Greek myth

explanation.surface: Merchandise was first transported aboard an old vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Freight carried by a ship or plane is its load of goods.

clue.text: Heard two deer and an extinct bird?

indicators.note: heard says the solver must go by how the words are spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a doe is a female deer, so two of them are doe doe

explanation.surface: Someone thinks they caught the sound of a pair of deer, and asks whether it was a lost bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless bird of Mauritius died out in the 17th century, the classic example of an extinct species.

clue.text: A horse with time to drink

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
taken as written

explanation.surface: A horse is given time to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: This almond-flavoured Italian liqueur is a kind of alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Greek god is poisoned, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests something has gone wrong, so the letters of poisoned are jumbled

explanation.surface: A deity has sadly been poisoned.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of the sea, the counterpart of Neptune.

clue.text: Young girl with old rope

parts.note: a lass is a young girl, especially in Scotland and northern England

explanation.surface: A girl is paired with a worn piece of cord.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy's noosed rope for catching cattle; here the noun is the rope itself.

clue.text: Slowly, plant covers centre of maze

indicators.note: covers means one piece is wrapped around another

parts.note: a lily is a flowering plant

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letters of maze

explanation.surface: Gradually a plant grows over the heart of a hedge maze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre of' gives AZ, the middle two letters of the four in 'maze'.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in an idle, unhurried way means doing it slowly.

clue.text: Iodine put in remedy for some radiation

indicators.note: put in tells us one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: a cure is a remedy for an illness
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: Iodine is added to a treatment that involves radiation.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a little cryptic: the curie is a unit of radioactivity, a measured amount of it, so 'some radiation'.
explanation.definitionFit: A curie is a unit measuring radioactivity, so it names a quantity of radiation.

clue.text: Quick, some medication — I'm bleeding!

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone cries out for medicine fast because they are bleeding.
explanation.definitionFit: Agile and swift in movement or thought: a synonym for quick.

clue.text: Focuses on size: er, that's unusual

indicators.note: unusual says the letters come in an unexpected order, so on, size and er are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone hesitantly comments on a strange obsession with size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's unusual' rearranges ON SIZE ER; 'er' looks like a hesitation but supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To home in on a target is to concentrate on it, an idiom from aiming weapons.

clue.text: Assist a wager

parts.note: a bet is a wager

explanation.surface: Help someone place a gamble.
explanation.definitionFit: To help, especially in wrongdoing: a synonym for aid or support.

clue.text: Stare unhappily, producing weapon

indicators.note: unhappily suggests things are out of sorts, so the letters of stare are rearranged

explanation.surface: A miserable glare produces a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A stun gun firing electrified darts, used by police as a weapon.

clue.text: Fly bite is raised up

indicators.note: raised up in a down clue means the word for bite is read from bottom to top

parts.note: tang is a sharp, biting taste

explanation.surface: An insect bite is swelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised up' reverses TANG in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A gnat is a small two-winged insect, a type of fly.

clue.text: Oddly, loud child is coherent

indicators.note: oddly picks the letters in the odd-numbered places of loud child

explanation.surface: Strangely, a noisy youngster is speaking sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Clear and easily understood, as in a coherent argument: a synonym.

clue.text: Prohibit boy's musical instruments

parts.note: to ban is to prohibit
Joe is a boy's name, so the boy's gives JOE'S

explanation.surface: Forbid a lad's guitars and drums.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of the round-bodied stringed instrument of bluegrass, here in an older spelling.

clue.text: Grave fellow and dangerous driver?

definitions.meaning: a funeral director, a man whose work is graves
someone who passes other cars on the wrong side, on the inside lane

explanation.surface: A solemn man is also reckless behind the wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grave' reads as serious but means burial place. Undertaking is the British term for passing on the inside, a risky move.
explanation.definitionFit: A funeral director deals with graves, and one who passes on the inside is a hazard on the road.
